question: Does Śaiva doctrine ever assert a real difference between power and the power-holder?
premises: Śiva and śakti have been declared inseparable.
Some views may posit difference between them.
The Śaiva position must be stated clearly.
inference: In the Śaiva doctrine, no difference between power and the power-holder is ever described.
plain_english: In the Śaiva teaching, no difference between power and the holder of power is ever asserted.
